verdict.rationale: Galileo's Python SDK, log decorators, OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing, and programmatic experiment running (galileo-gh-1, galileo-docs-2, galileo-docs-6, galileo-docs-7) all indicate the platform can be driven headlessly/programmatically rather than only via the console UI, which is the basis for CI usage. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline example, GitHub Actions integration, or documented CLI/automation workflow for running evaluations in a pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guide or example, dedicated CLI for headless runs, confirmation of exit-code/pass-fail gating for pipelines.
